name: blocks a commit that leaves out JOURNAL.md
script: echo change >> a.txt && git add a.txt && git commit -q -m change
stderr_contains: goodvibes: this commit leaves out JOURNAL.md

name: allows a commit that includes JOURNAL.md
script: echo change >> a.txt && echo entry >> JOURNAL.md && git add a.txt JOURNAL.md && git commit -q -m change

name: allows a commit of only JOURNAL.md
script: echo entry >> JOURNAL.md && git add JOURNAL.md && git commit -q -m journal

name: allows any commit in a repo without JOURNAL.md
script: git rm -q JOURNAL.md && git commit -q --no-verify -m drop && echo change >> a.txt && git add a.txt && git commit -q -m change

name: allows a commit that deletes JOURNAL.md
script: git rm -q JOURNAL.md && git commit -q -m drop

name: does not count a JOURNAL.md in a subfolder
script: mkdir -p docs && echo x > docs/JOURNAL.md && echo change >> a.txt && git add a.txt docs/JOURNAL.md && git commit -q -m change

name: allows commit -a when JOURNAL.md has changes
script: echo change >> a.txt && echo entry >> JOURNAL.md && git commit -q -a -m change

name: blocks commit -a when JOURNAL.md is unchanged
script: echo change >> a.txt && git commit -q -a -m change

name: blocks a commit of a named path when JOURNAL.md is only staged, not named
script: echo change >> a.txt && echo entry >> JOURNAL.md && git add JOURNAL.md && git commit -q -m change a.txt

name: blocks the first commit of a new file when JOURNAL.md exists but is not staged
script: echo new > b.txt && git add b.txt && git commit -q -m add

name: blocks an amend that adds a file without JOURNAL.md
script: echo change >> a.txt && git add a.txt && git commit -q --amend -m more

name: allows concluding a merge after resolving a conflict
script: git checkout -q -b side && echo side > a.txt && git commit -q --no-verify -am side && git checkout -q - && echo main > a.txt && git commit -q --no-verify -am main && { git merge -q side >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; } && echo resolved > a.txt && git add a.txt && git commit -q --no-edit

name: allows git commit --no-verify
script: echo change >> a.txt && git add a.txt && git commit -q --no-verify -m change

name: allows the commit when GOODVIBES_JOURNAL_CHECK is off
script: echo change >> a.txt && git add a.txt && GOODVIBES_JOURNAL_CHECK=off git commit -q -m change

name: checks the repository when committing from a subfolder
script: mkdir -p src && echo x > src/x.txt && cd src && git add x.txt && git commit -q -m add

name: tells the user how to skip the check once
script: echo change >> a.txt && git add a.txt && git commit -q -m change
stderr_contains: To skip the check once: git commit --no-verify

name: does not run a core.fsmonitor program set in the repository config
script: echo change >> a.txt && echo entry >> JOURNAL.md && git add a.txt JOURNAL.md && git config core.fsmonitor "touch $PWD/fsmonitor-ran; false" && .git/hooks/pre-commit; test ! -e fsmonitor-ran
